info.title: Salve Mundi iPhone API
info.description: Acceptance-only API contract. Requires ENV_NAME=acc and MOBILE_API_ENABLED=true. All private endpoints require an app credential; credentials, QR tokens and user data must not be logged. Registration/payment state is authoritative on the server.

get.summary: Get an activity by namespaced ID

post.summary: Register the authenticated member using server pricing and capacity rules

patch.summary: Update own phone number; names and membership remain managed by existing association systems

post.summary: Associate this APNs token with the authenticated app session

delete.summary: Remove this member’s APNs device registration

post.summary: Consume a one-use PKCE-bound login code
Revoke the app session and its device registration

get.summary: Start Microsoft sign-in in the system authentication browser

302.description: Redirect to Microsoft sign-in or PKCE callback

get.summary: Read current activity-administration capability and scope version
List only activities and committees currently authorized for this member

post.summary: Create an activity with leader and destination-committee checks

get.summary: Read authorized activity details and editor fields

patch.summary: Update the complete activity form after current scope checks

delete.summary: Delete an authorized activity; no automatic refund

post.summary: Upload authorized activity image/video, maximum 10 MB

get.summary: Read participants with current per-activity authorization

post.summary: Explicit manual confirmed registration; no payment charged

delete.summary: Cancel only a participant belonging to this authorized activity; no automatic refund

patch.summary: Set attendance after activity and participant ownership checks

post.summary: Verify a paid QR ticket against this activity and check in idempotently
Send a user-confirmed announcement to server-resolved event participants

get.summary: Search members for manual registration; requires edit role

post.summary: Issue a counts-only credential bounded by the current native session

get.summary: Read at most eight authorized current/upcoming count summaries; never participant data

AdminWidgetSession.description: Counts-only scoped credential; valid solely for GET /admin/widget-activities. Parent session and live committee rights checked on every read.

registrationViaWebsite.description: Open websiteURL for registration instead of calling the registration endpoint.

Error.description: Request failed; JSON error, never a website login redirect
